description: fitz-gov curated test corpus - 378 documents designed to test governance behaviors

purpose.abstention: Documents in unrelated domains (e.g., biology docs for business queries)
purpose.dispute: Multiple documents with conflicting information on the same topic
purpose.trustworthy_hedged: Documents showing correlations/effects without causal explanations
purpose.grounding: Documents discussing topics but lacking specific details (hallucination traps)

notes: Curated mix of synthetic documents designed to match the expanded 4.0 benchmark. Includes documents for 330 new/converted test cases across dispute, abstention, trustworthy direct, and trustworthy hedged categories. Enhanced with multi-source perspectives, structured data formats, and domain expansion.
